patches_modified.name: Equaliser per output
patches_modified.description: Remembers BitChord's equaliser for each output (speaker, wired, each Bluetooth device) and puts it back when that output is used; shares settings as codes. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Headphone correction
patches_modified.description: Flattens your headphones' sound with a measured profile, one per output, from AutoEq's thousands of models or pasted in. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Install as Bitchord+

patches_modified.name: JamesDSP
patches_modified.description: Hands BitChord's audio to JamesDSP, the open-source effect engine: open it from BitChord, announce the audio session again and let it take over the effects. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Lossless addons over Bluetooth
patches_modified.description: Keeps addons marked lossless in use over Bluetooth, where BitChord normally skips them. Lossless-first, as in Auris by OreoMuncher45. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Loudness level
patches_modified.description: Sets how loud loudness normalisation plays songs, from -23 to -8 LUFS instead of -14. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Mixed-source playlists
patches_modified.description: Adds signed-out playlist links, editable device copies, queue saving, native file import and reviewed two-way Spotify/YouTube Music playlist sync. Keeps files and streams together with full source metadata across restarts. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Per-download quality
patches_modified.description: Asks which quality to download each song in: Standard, High or Lossless. An album is asked about once. From Stash by Rawnald Clark. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Pitch control
patches_modified.description: Moves the key up or down by up to 12 semitones without changing the speed. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Play alongside other apps
patches_modified.description: Keeps the music playing when another app plays sound, such as a reel or a video, instead of pausing. Calls still pause it. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Sign in with MicroG
patches_modified.description: Offers to sign in to YouTube Music with an account that's already in MicroG RE, instead of Google's sign-in page.

patches_modified.name: Sleep timer fade-out
patches_modified.description: Fades the song out before the sleep timer pauses it, and fades the end of the last song with the timer's "After this song" option. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Smart downloads
patches_modified.description: Downloads the songs you play most, on Wi-Fi, so they're there without a signal. Uses BitChord's listening statistics and its Download quality; songs you delete aren't downloaded again. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Steady playback
patches_modified.description: Reads further ahead, through the rest of the song and into the next ones, with separate limits for Wi-Fi and mobile data, and waits through a lost signal instead of stopping. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Streamseek previews
patches_modified.description: Preview explicitly selected Soulseek audio while it transfers: FLAC, WAV/AIFF, ALAC, APE, WavPack, TTA/TAK, WMA Lossless and DSD, plus MP3. A dedicated on-device FFmpeg decoder feeds Media3. Keep download reuses buffered bytes. Compare an excerpt with a known local reference and export transparent evidence. Optional; enable in Patches & tweaks. No automatic Soulseek playback or Mornye integration.
